26.original: Deliver the Zephyros 72s to the Thalassai observer.

48.original: May I ask a favor? A colleague of mine from the Thalassai is overdue to make his report, and I need someone to give him a gentle nudge.

49.original: He's currently over at Rumination's Ramble, observing some life-forms newly hatched from one of our creations, but I'm afraid I'll skew the data if I show up and startle them.

50.original: A familiar like you, however, should cause much less of a disruption. Would you be so kind...?

51.original: You can find my associate at Rumination's Ramble.

56.original: A familiar? Can I help you with something?

57.original: Oh, time to head back, is it? I was so enraptured watching the young ones frolic that I lost track of time.

58.original: Come, come, everyone! We really must be going!

60.original: Still want to play, do you? I guess we shall have to appeal to your bellies, then!

61.original: Would you like to try feeding them?

62.original: They become much more compliant after eating some of these treats. And they're so adorable when they nibble!

63.original: Go ahead and feed them some treats.

72.original: Isn't it fun watching them romp around?

73.original: And they really seemed to like you! Do you work with young ones often?

74.original: These babies are aquatic creatures by nature, but we're modifying them to adapt to life on land.

75.original: They mostly eat marine insects and shellfish, and some of the larger carnivores feed off them in turn.

76.original: They also carry their eggs on their backs until they're ready to hatch. Fascinating, aren't they?

77.original: Oh, but that's not why you're here, is it!? I really must head back!

78.original: Thank you for fetching my associate.

79.original: If you hadn't been sent to fetch me, I might have been out there for days.

80.original: In any case, it's only a matter of time before our creations are approved for release into the wild. I wonder what name they'll receive...

81.original: Thank you for all your help today. Here, as thanks.
